name: Posada de Valdeón (Spain)
description: White field with a broad blue horizontal stripe across the centre, charged with four red discs above and four below.
history: Municipal flag of Posada de Valdeón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: broad horizontal stripe across the centre
four discs in a row above the stripe
four discs in a row below the stripe
